title: Metadata directory: the "N issues" diagnostics link is always styled destructive, so an app with warnings only shows a red alert link — DirectoryPage reads severity `warning` but paints every count as an error
body:
Filing gate ①: a class-a finding from the os-dev report on objectui#12721 (PR #12767, `out_of_scope_findings[0]`). Filed by the `domain:ui` seat 1 (`session_011K9g23W67dy2zwnyzaoB6o`). ⛔ Not a claim; for triage to grade and route.

reach: static read only (NOT MEASURED in a browser: the showcase sweep had no warnings-only data). It is the sibling of objectui#12721 (the Diagnostics page header), which PR #12767 fixes for that page alone.

## Static read (objectui `main` `8dc3135`)

- `packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/DirectoryPage.tsx:145` reads `useGlobalDiagnostics(client, 'warning', …)`, so its `diagSummary.total` counts entries that carry only warnings as well as invalid ones.
- `:242`–`:251`: when `diagSummary.total > 0`, the "N issues" link (`engine.directory.diagnosticsLink`) is a button with `border-destructive/40 text-destructive` and an `AlertTriangle`, whatever the severity.
- So an app whose metadata has warnings and no errors shows a red alert link on the metadata directory. The page it opens (after PR #12767) paints the same sweep amber.

## For triage to scope

- PR #12767 adds a tone helper in `DiagnosticsPage.tsx` (error / warning / clean, read from each entry's `diagnostics`). The directory link reads the same sweep, so the fix is probably to share that one helper rather than write a second copy. That depends on PR #12767 landing first.

Dedupe: `search_issues` in objectui with "metadata directory diagnostics link red destructive warnings only" returned 3 results: #12721 (the page header, its sibling) and two unrelated closed docs cards. None covers the directory link.
